name: Forms and paperwork
sub: Fillable forms with signatures, automatic reminders, and a clear list of who still hasn't signed.
get: Parents fill out and sign from their portal, and templates cover common forms like medical releases and travel forms.
The acknowledgements page shows everyone who has, and hasn't, signed the handbook or a policy.
cta: Bring the permission slip you used last year.

faq.q: Can parents sign on a phone?
faq.a: Yes. They can also use a tablet or computer.

faq.q: Who can see a signed form?
faq.a: Only staff with access to forms, and the family it belongs to.

steps.body: Upload the PDF you already use, start from a template, or build a form from scratch.
